+"""Task prompts for instruction-tuned embedding models.
+
+Checkpoints published for Sentence Transformers carry a prompt catalog in
+``config_sentence_transformers.json`` (prompt name -> text to prepend). Reading
+it from the checkpoint keeps the prompt wording with the model: EmbeddingGemma 2
+answers ``clustering`` with ``task: clustering | query: ``, Qwen3-Embedding
+answers ``search_query`` with its retrieval instruction, and a model with no
+catalog embeds the text unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from schemas import EmbeddingTask
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("mlx-server")
+
+PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE = "config_sentence_transformers.json"
+
+# Catalog prompt names for each task, most specific first. Names follow the
+# Sentence Transformers conventions used by published checkpoints.
+TASK_PROMPT_NAMES: dict[EmbeddingTask, tuple[str, ...]] = {
+    EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING: ("Clustering",),
+    EmbeddingTask.SEARCH_QUERY: ("SearchQuery", "Retrieval-query", "query"),
+    EmbeddingTask.DOCUMENT: ("Document", "Retrieval-document", "document"),
+    EmbeddingTask.CLASSIFICATION: ("Classification",),
+    EmbeddingTask.SIMILARITY: ("SentenceSimilarity", "STS"),
+}
+
+
+def find_prompt_catalog(model_id: str) -> Path | None:
+    """Locate the prompt catalog of an already-downloaded model.
+
+    ``model_id`` is a local directory or a Hugging Face repo id. Only the local
+    cache is consulted, so call this after the model has been loaded.
+    """
+    local = Path(model_id) / PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE
+    if local.is_file():
+        return local
+
+    from huggingface_hub import try_to_load_from_cache
+
+    try:
+        cached = try_to_load_from_cache(model_id, PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE)
+    except ValueError:  # not a valid repo id, e.g. a missing local path
+        return None
+    # A str is a cached file; anything else means absent or not cached.
+    return Path(cached) if isinstance(cached, str) else None
+
+
+def load_prompt_catalog(model_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return the model's prompt catalog, or an empty one if it has none."""
+    path = find_prompt_catalog(model_id)
+    if path is None:
+        return {}
+    try:
+        catalog = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        logger.warning("Ignoring unreadable prompt catalog %s: %s", path, exc)
+        return {}
+    prompts = catalog.get("prompts") if isinstance(catalog, dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(prompts, dict):
+        return {}
+    return {
+        name: text
+        for name, text in prompts.items()
+        if isinstance(name, str) and isinstance(text, str)
+    }
+
+
+def task_prompt(catalog: dict[str, str], task: EmbeddingTask | None) -> str:
+    """Return the text to prepend for ``task``; empty if the model has none."""
+    if task is None:
+        return ""
+    for name in TASK_PROMPT_NAMES[task]:
+        if name in catalog:
+            return catalog[name]
+    return ""
+
+
+def apply_task_prompt(
+    catalog: dict[str, str], task: EmbeddingTask | None, texts: list[str]
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Prepend the task prompt to each text, as Sentence Transformers does."""
+    prompt = task_prompt(catalog, task)
+    return [prompt + text for text in texts] if prompt else texts

+"""Task prompts and the mlx-vlm fallback for text embeddings.
+
+The models are faked; real MLX arrays are used so results pass through the
+server's usual conversion.
+"""
+
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+mx = pytest.importorskip("mlx.core")
+mlx_embeddings = pytest.importorskip("mlx_embeddings")
+
+import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient  # noqa: E402
+
+import prompts  # noqa: E402
+import registry  # noqa: E402
+import server  # noqa: E402
+from registry import EmbedBackend  # noqa: E402
+from schemas import EmbeddingTask  # noqa: E402
+
+GEMMA_PROMPTS = {
+    "Clustering": "task: clustering | query: ",
+    "SearchQuery": "task: search result | query: ",
+    "Document": "title: none | text: ",
+    "query": "task: search result | query: ",
+    "document": "title: none | text: ",
+}
+QWEN_PROMPTS = {"query": "Instruct: retrieve passages\nQuery:", "document": ""}
+
+
+def write_catalog(directory, catalog):
+    path = directory / prompts.PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({"prompts": catalog}))
+    return path
+
+
+# --- prompt catalog ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_catalog_is_read_from_a_local_model_directory(tmp_path):
+    write_catalog(tmp_path, GEMMA_PROMPTS)
+    assert prompts.load_prompt_catalog(str(tmp_path)) == GEMMA_PROMPTS
+
+
+def test_model_without_a_catalog_has_no_prompts(tmp_path):
+    assert prompts.load_prompt_catalog(str(tmp_path)) == {}
+    assert prompts.load_prompt_catalog("not-cached/model") == {}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("content", ["not json", "[]", '{"prompts": ["a"]}'])
+def test_malformed_catalog_is_ignored(tmp_path, content):
+    (tmp_path / prompts.PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE).write_text(content)
+    assert prompts.load_prompt_catalog(str(tmp_path)) == {}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("catalog", "task", "expected"),
+    [
+        (GEMMA_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING, "task: clustering | query: "),
+        (GEMMA_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.SEARCH_QUERY, "task: search result | query: "),
+        (GEMMA_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.DOCUMENT, "title: none | text: "),
+        # Falls back to the generic name when the specific one is absent.
+        (
+            QWEN_PROMPTS,
+            EmbeddingTask.SEARCH_QUERY,
+            "Instruct: retrieve passages\nQuery:",
+        ),
+        (QWEN_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.DOCUMENT, ""),
+        # The model has no prompt for the task.
+        (QWEN_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING, ""),
+        (GEMMA_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.CLASSIFICATION, ""),
+        ({}, EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING, ""),
+        (GEMMA_PROMPTS, None, ""),
+    ],
+)
+def test_task_prompt(catalog, task, expected):
+    assert prompts.task_prompt(catalog, task) == expected
+
+
+def test_every_task_has_prompt_names():
+    assert set(prompts.TASK_PROMPT_NAMES) == set(EmbeddingTask)
+
+
+def test_apply_task_prompt_prepends_without_a_separator():
+    texts = ["rust 1.90 is out", "new M5 chips"]
+    assert prompts.apply_task_prompt(
+        GEMMA_PROMPTS, EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING, texts
+    ) == [
+        "task: clustering | query: rust 1.90 is out",
+        "task: clustering | query: new M5 chips",
+    ]
+    assert prompts.apply_task_prompt({}, EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING, texts) == texts
+    assert prompts.apply_task_prompt(GEMMA_PROMPTS, None, texts) == texts
+
+
+# --- registry fallback and the endpoint -------------------------------------
+
+
+class FakeTokenizer:
+    """Records what it was asked to tokenize; one token per character."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.batches: list[list[str]] = []
+
+    def __call__(self, texts, **kwargs):
+        self.batches.append(list(texts))
+        width = max(len(t) for t in texts)
+        mask = np.array([[1] * len(t) + [0] * (width - len(t)) for t in texts])
+        return {"input_ids": mask.copy(), "attention_mask": mask}
+
+    @property
+    def seen(self) -> list[str]:
+        return [text for batch in self.batches for text in batch]

+    def __call__(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
+        lengths = attention_mask.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True).astype(mx.float32)
+        embeds = mx.concatenate([lengths, mx.ones_like(lengths)], axis=-1)
+        return type("Output", (), {"text_embeds": embeds})()

+        "/v1/embeddings", json={"model": model_id, "input": texts, **extra}

+
+
+def test_unsupported_architecture_falls_back_to_mlx_vlm(vlm_embedder):
+    model_id = vlm_embedder["model_id"]
+    with TestClient(server.app) as client:
+        first = embed(client, model_id, ["ab", "abcd"])
+        second = embed(client, model_id, ["a"])

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("task", "prefix"),
+    [
+        ("clustering", "task: clustering | query: "),
+        ("search_query", "task: search result | query: "),
+        ("document", "title: none | text: "),
+        ("classification", ""),  # not in this model's catalog

+def test_task_selects_the_prompt_from_the_model_catalog(vlm_embedder, task, prefix):

+
+
+def test_unknown_task_is_rejected(vlm_embedder):
+    with TestClient(server.app) as client:
+        response = embed(client, vlm_embedder["model_id"], ["hello"], task="poetry")

+
+def test_large_requests_are_batched_in_input_order(vlm_embedder):
+    texts = ["x" * (i + 1) for i in range(server._EMBED_BATCH_SIZE * 2 + 3)]
+    with TestClient(server.app) as client:

+    ]
+    assert [len(b) for b in vlm_embedder["tokenizer"].batches] == [
+        server._EMBED_BATCH_SIZE,
+        server._EMBED_BATCH_SIZE,
+        3,
+    ]

+    with TestClient(server.app) as client:

465	def _maybe_build_optiq_prompt_cache(model, model_id: str):
466	    """Create a TurboQuant prompt cache for OptiQ mlx-lm models when possible."""
467	    if "optiq" not in model_id.lower():
468	        return None
469	
470	    try:
471	        from optiq.core.turbo_kv_cache import TurboQuantKVCache, patch_attention
472	    except ImportError:
473	        logger.warning(
474	            "OptiQ model %s selected but mlx-optiq is unavailable; using standard cache",
475	            model_id,
476	        )
477	        return None
478	
479	    try:
480	        global _OPTIQ_ATTENTION_PATCHED
481	        if not _OPTIQ_ATTENTION_PATCHED:
482	            patch_attention()
483	            _OPTIQ_ATTENTION_PATCHED = True
484	
485	        cache = model.make_cache()
486	        patched_layers = 0
487	        for i, layer in enumerate(_iter_attention_layers(model)):
488	            attn = getattr(layer, "self_attn", None)
489	            head_dim = getattr(attn, "head_dim", None)
490	            if head_dim is None:
491	                continue
492	            cache[i] = TurboQuantKVCache(head_dim=head_dim, bits=4, seed=42 + i)
493	            patched_layers += 1
494	
495	        if patched_layers == 0:
496	            logger.warning(
497	                "OptiQ model %s exposed no self-attention layers for TurboQuant cache",
498	                model_id,
499	            )
500	            return None
501	
502	        logger.info(
503	            "Enabled mlx-optiq TurboQuant cache for %s across %d layers",
504	            model_id,
505	            patched_layers,
506	        )
507	        return cache
508	    except Exception:
509	        logger.warning(
510	            "Failed to enable mlx-optiq cache for %s; falling back to standard cache",
511	            model_id,
512	            exc_info=True,
513	        )
514	        return None

517	def _iter_attention_layers(model):
518	    """Return the model layer sequence used to build prompt caches."""
519	    direct_layers = getattr(model, "layers", None)
520	    if direct_layers is not None:
521	        return direct_layers
522	
523	    nested_model = getattr(model, "model", None)
524	    nested_layers = getattr(nested_model, "layers", None)
525	    if nested_layers is not None:
526	        return nested_layers
527	
528	    return []

531	def _strip_thinking(text: str) -> str:
532	    """Remove reasoning/thinking blocks from generated text.
533	
534	    Handles multiple formats:
535	    - <think>...</think> (Qwen, DeepSeek)
536	    - <channel|>...<|channel> and <|channel>...<channel|> (Gemma 4)
537	    """
538	    import re
539	
540	    # <think>...</think> — greedy within blocks, DOTALL for multiline
541	    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
542	    # Unclosed <think> at the start — strip everything from <think> onward
543	    if "<think>" in text:
544	        text = text[: text.index("<think>")]
545	    text = _strip_gemma_channel_blocks(text)
546	    return text.strip()
547	
548	
549	def _strip_gemma_channel_blocks(text: str) -> str:
550	    """Strip Gemma 4 reasoning blocks in either channel-token order."""
551	    result: list[str] = []
552	    rest = text
553	
554	    while True:
555	        normal = rest.find("<channel|>")
556	        reversed_ = rest.find("<|channel>")
557	
558	        if normal == -1 and reversed_ == -1:
559	            break
560	
561	        if normal != -1 and (reversed_ == -1 or normal <= reversed_):
562	            start, open_tag, close_tag = normal, "<channel|>", "<|channel>"
563	        else:
564	            start, open_tag, close_tag = reversed_, "<|channel>", "<channel|>"
565	
566	        result.append(rest[:start])
567	        rest = rest[start + len(open_tag) :]
568	
569	        end = rest.find(close_tag)
570	        if end == -1:
571	            return "".join(result)
572	        rest = rest[end + len(close_tag) :]
573	
574	    result.append(rest)
575	    return "".join(result)

63	    """Load a text embedding model through mlx-vlm, without its media towers.
64	
65	    Weights keep the dtype stored in the checkpoint. Do not cast them:
66	    EmbeddingGemma 2 overflows float16 and returns NaN or degraded vectors.

82	class ModelRegistry:

85	    def __init__(self, default_model: str | None = None) -> None:
86	        self._text_models: dict[str, TextEmbedder] = {}
87	        self._vl_models: dict[str, tuple[Any, Any]] = {}
88	        self._chat_models: dict[str, tuple[ChatBackend, Any, Any]] = {}

91	    def get_text_model(self, model_id: str) -> TextEmbedder:
92	        """Return the loaded text embedding model for ``model_id``.
93	
94	        Tries mlx_embeddings first. If the model architecture is unsupported,
95	        falls back to mlx_vlm (e.g. EmbeddingGemma 2).
96	        """
97	        if model_id not in self._text_models:
98	            try:
99	                from mlx_embeddings import load
100	
101	                logger.info("Trying mlx_embeddings for: %s", model_id)
102	                model, tokenizer = load(model_id)
103	                backend = EmbedBackend.MLX_EMBEDDINGS
104	            except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
105	                # Architecture not supported by mlx_embeddings — try mlx_vlm
106	                logger.info(
107	                    "mlx_embeddings unsupported for %s (%s), falling back to mlx_vlm",
108	                    model_id,

112	                backend = EmbedBackend.MLX_VLM

123	        unsupported, falls back to mlx_vlm (vision-language models like gemma-4).
124	        """
125	        if model_id not in self._chat_models:
126	            try:
127	                from mlx_lm import load
128	
129	                logger.info("Trying mlx_lm for: %s", model_id)
130	                loaded = load(model_id, lazy=True)
131	                model = loaded[0]
132	                tokenizer = loaded[1]
133	                self._chat_models[model_id] = (ChatBackend.MLX_LM, model, tokenizer)
134	                logger.info("Loaded %s via mlx_lm", model_id)
135	            except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
136	                # Architecture not supported by mlx_lm — try mlx_vlm
137	                logger.info(
138	                    "mlx_lm unsupported for %s (%s), falling back to mlx_vlm",
139	                    model_id,
140	                    exc,
141	                )
142	                from mlx_vlm import load
143	
144	                model, processor = load(model_id)
145	                self._chat_models[model_id] = (ChatBackend.MLX_VLM, model, processor)
146	                logger.info("Loaded %s via mlx_vlm", model_id)
147	        return self._chat_models[model_id]

149	    def get_vl_model(self, model_id: str) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
150	        """Return (model, processor) for a vision-language model."""
151	        if model_id not in self._vl_models:
152	            from mlx_vlm import load
153	
154	            model, processor = load(model_id)
155	            self._vl_models[model_id] = (model, processor)
156	        return self._vl_models[model_id]

159	        """Drop every cached model.

162	        must not outlive that thread. Call this on the MLX thread before it

1	"""Task prompts for instruction-tuned embedding models.
2	
3	Checkpoints published for Sentence Transformers carry a prompt catalog in
4	``config_sentence_transformers.json`` (prompt name -> text to prepend). Reading
5	it from the checkpoint keeps the prompt wording with the model: EmbeddingGemma 2
6	answers ``clustering`` with ``task: clustering | query: ``, Qwen3-Embedding
7	answers ``search_query`` with its retrieval instruction, and a model with no
8	catalog embeds the text unchanged.
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import json
14	import logging
15	from pathlib import Path
16	
17	from schemas import EmbeddingTask
18	
19	logger = logging.getLogger("mlx-server")
20	
21	PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE = "config_sentence_transformers.json"
22	
23	# Catalog prompt names for each task, most specific first. Names follow the
24	# Sentence Transformers conventions used by published checkpoints.
25	TASK_PROMPT_NAMES: dict[EmbeddingTask, tuple[str, ...]] = {
26	    EmbeddingTask.CLUSTERING: ("Clustering",),
27	    EmbeddingTask.SEARCH_QUERY: ("SearchQuery", "Retrieval-query", "query"),
28	    EmbeddingTask.DOCUMENT: ("Document", "Retrieval-document", "document"),
29	    EmbeddingTask.CLASSIFICATION: ("Classification",),
30	    EmbeddingTask.SIMILARITY: ("SentenceSimilarity", "STS"),
31	}
32	
33	
34	def find_prompt_catalog(model_id: str) -> Path | None:
35	    """Locate the prompt catalog of an already-downloaded model.
36	
37	    ``model_id`` is a local directory or a Hugging Face repo id. Only the local
38	    cache is consulted, so call this after the model has been loaded.
39	    """
40	    local = Path(model_id) / PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE
41	    if local.is_file():
42	        return local
43	
44	    from huggingface_hub import try_to_load_from_cache
45	
46	    try:
47	        cached = try_to_load_from_cache(model_id, PROMPT_CATALOG_FILE)
48	    except ValueError:  # not a valid repo id, e.g. a missing local path
49	        return None
50	    # A str is a cached file; anything else means absent or not cached.
51	    return Path(cached) if isinstance(cached, str) else None
52	
53	
54	def load_prompt_catalog(model_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
55	    """Return the model's prompt catalog, or an empty one if it has none."""
56	    path = find_prompt_catalog(model_id)
57	    if path is None:
58	        return {}
59	    try:
60	        catalog = json.loads(path.read_text())
61	    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
62	        logger.warning("Ignoring unreadable prompt catalog %s: %s", path, exc)
63	        return {}
64	    prompts = catalog.get("prompts") if isinstance(catalog, dict) else None
65	    if not isinstance(prompts, dict):
66	        return {}
67	    return {
68	        name: text
69	        for name, text in prompts.items()
70	        if isinstance(name, str) and isinstance(text, str)
71	    }
72	
73	
74	def task_prompt(catalog: dict[str, str], task: EmbeddingTask | None) -> str:
75	    """Return the text to prepend for ``task``; empty if the model has none."""
76	    if task is None:
77	        return ""
78	    for name in TASK_PROMPT_NAMES[task]:
79	        if name in catalog:
80	            return catalog[name]
81	    return ""
82	
83	
84	def apply_task_prompt(
85	    catalog: dict[str, str], task: EmbeddingTask | None, texts: list[str]
86	) -> list[str]:
87	    """Prepend the task prompt to each text, as Sentence Transformers does."""
88	    prompt = task_prompt(catalog, task)
89	    return [prompt + text for text in texts] if prompt else texts
